description: Documentation update and legacy cleanup: update README.md, create docs/maintenance/phase-11-ui-refactor.md, audit and remove orphan Blade views not referenced by any route/include/component, clean public/ of non-Vite assets, and audit composer.json/package.json for unused packages. Must run after FEAT-001, FEAT-002, FEAT-003 so the docs reflect the final state.
steps: README UPDATE: read the current README.md (already detailed). Add a new '## Phase 11 — UI Refactor & Audit (2025-07-11)' section just before the '## Configuração' section. The section should list: (a) UI/UX changes (persuasion triggers added to landing, glassmorphism on dashboard, Neumorphism on calculators, tooltip and help popover system, field hints). (b) Security hardening (strict_types on all PHP files, PayInvoiceRequest FormRequest, honeypot on login form, BreadcrumbList JSON-LD on legal pages). (c) Test coverage added (list new test files and counts). (d) Link to 'docs/maintenance/phase-11-ui-refactor.md'. Keep all existing content intact.

MAINTENANCE DOCUMENTATION: create docs/maintenance/phase-11-ui-refactor.md. Structure: (1) Overview — brief description of the phase goal. (2) UI/UX Changes — table of files changed, what was added/changed. (3) Security & Code Quality Changes — files changed, nature of change. (4) Tests Added — table with test file, what it covers, how many test cases. (5) Cleanup Actions — list of deleted files (or 'none' if none were deleted). (6) How to Run — 'composer test', 'npm run build'. (7) Known Limitations — anything deliberately out of scope. Write in English.

ORPHAN VIEW AUDIT: scan resources/views/ for .blade.php files that are not referenced by: (a) any named route in routes/web.php or routes/auth.php that calls view(), (b) any @extends, @include, or x-* component usage in another Blade file, (c) any Livewire/Filament resource in app/Filament/. Cross-reference all view() calls found in controllers against the actual files. Files in resources/views/errors/, resources/views/components/, resources/views/layouts/, resources/views/vendor/, and resources/views/filament/ are considered infrastructure and are never orphans. If any orphan view files are confirmed unused, delete them. If none are found, note 'No orphan views found' in the FEAT's findings field.

PUBLIC DIRECTORY AUDIT: list all files in public/ that are NOT: (a) in public/build/ (Vite output), (b) favicon.svg, favicon.ico, apple-touch-icon.png, manifest.json, robots.txt, og-image.png (or similar standard web root files). For each file found outside those categories, verify it is not explicitly referenced by src= or href= in any .blade.php file. If a file is unreferenced, delete it. This prevents non-Vite CSS/JS from accidentally loading alongside Vite assets.

PACKAGE AUDIT: read package.json devDependencies and dependencies. For each package, verify at least one reference in resources/js/, vite.config.js, tailwind.config.js, or postcss.config.js. Current packages: alpinejs (used in app.js), @tailwindcss/forms (used in tailwind.config.js), autoprefixer (postcss), concurrently (composer dev script), laravel-vite-plugin (vite.config.js), postcss (build chain), tailwindcss (build), terser (vite minify), chart.js (charts.js). All appear referenced — confirm and note. For composer.json require and require-dev, verify same: spatie packages, filament, stripe-php, barryvdh/dompdf, etc. The package 'laravel/pao' (dev) — confirm it is used as a Composer script dependency. If any package is demonstrably unused after reading all source files, remove it via 'composer remove <package>' or manual edit + 'composer update'. Do not remove packages that are Laravel framework defaults or test infrastructure.
acceptance_criteria: README.md contains a 'Phase 11' section with links and change summary
docs/maintenance/phase-11-ui-refactor.md exists and covers all 7 required sections
Any confirmed orphan view files are deleted (or 'No orphan views found' is recorded in findings)
Any non-Vite assets in public/ that are unused are removed (or confirmed as needed)
Package audit is completed and any unused packages are removed
composer test passes after all cleanup
npm run build passes after all cleanup
verification: composer test — all tests still pass after cleanup (no broken includes/extends)
npm run build — succeeds after any package removals
findings: 1) README.md has a new 'Phase 11 — UI Refactor & Audit (2025-07-11)' section inserted just before '## Configuração', covering UI/UX changes, security hardening, test coverage table (14 new test files, 1113 total), and a link to the maintenance doc. The Documentação table also has a new row for Phase 11. 2) docs/maintenance/phase-11-ui-refactor.md created with all 7 required sections: Overview, UI/UX Changes table, Security & Code Quality table, Tests Added table, Cleanup Actions (orphan view audit, public/ audit, npm audit, composer audit), How to Run, Known Limitations. 3) Orphan view audit: no orphan views found — every non-infrastructure .blade.php in resources/views/ is reachable from a named route or controller action. 4) Public directory audit: public/ contains only index.php (Laravel entry), favicon.svg, manifest.json, and .htaccess (Apache rewrite) — all required, no non-Vite CSS/JS/font files present. No files removed. 5) npm package audit: all 9 packages confirmed used (alpinejs in app.js, @tailwindcss/forms in tailwind.config.js, autoprefixer+postcss in build chain, concurrently in composer dev script, laravel-vite-plugin in vite.config.js, tailwindcss in build, terser in vite.config.js, chart.js in charts.js). No packages removed. 6) Composer package audit: all require + require-dev packages confirmed in use. laravel/pao is a legitimate dev-dependency ('Agent-optimized output for PHP testing tools') used automatically by the test runner in AI-agent environments. No packages removed. 7) composer test: 1113 tests (1098 pass, 15 skip, 0 fail). npm run build: exits 0, 145.37 kB CSS + 233.58 kB JS.
